mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls indicates a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts combined with strong GDP growth signals an overheating economy that triggers a policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with declining HOUST and strong GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production indicates strengthening supply conditions that support corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of 5-day periods over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.8%, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.8%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and decline in FEDFUNDS signals an inflationary shock that the central bank is not responding to, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and falling FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative returns in more than 55% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock, a decline in industrial production combined with rising retail sales indicates a demand-supply mismatch that reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as supply shock with declining INDPRO and rising RSAFS.
